<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/account/{account}/webhooks/failed"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Lists webhook deliveries that failed for good, most recent first: every attempt failed, or the failure was permanent. Each entry says what the event was about and why the last attempt failed; the event payload itself is not included. With an account filter, the most recent failed deliveries of the whole queue are scanned for that account, and `scanLimited` says when the scan stopped before the end of the queue. How many failed deliveries are kept is set by EENGINE_QUEUE_KEEP_FAILED and EENGINE_QUEUE_KEEP_FAILED_AGE.
